note: PLACEHOLDER: the ring the claw tip reaches with the elbow taped (needs.md A10d). scripts/ring_calibrate.py fits centre_cm, radius_cm, scale and offset_deg from 5 points (base angle, tip position in sheet cm) and sets placeholder false. slots_deg (base angles on the ring) are set by hand once the base range is re-measured. camera_clear is set by hand (base 90, shoulder 90, Girik 4 Nov). The pick numbers are pick_once.py's; command_s is a guess until pick_once.py --measure-latency. A point more than max_off_ring_cm from the ring is refused.
